meal.title: Use class_ to search for CSS classes
meal.objective: Use the class_ parameter when searching for a CSS class

voice.script: Why does BeautifulSoup use class_ instead of class? When you search for a CSS class, Python's class keyword would cause a syntax error. BeautifulSoup avoids that by naming the parameter class_ with an underscore. For example, to find a div with class article, write article_div = soup.find('div', class_='article'). This tells BeautifulSoup to look for the HTML class attribute without breaking the code. Remember, always use class_ when specifying a CSS class in find or find_all. Try finding all span tags with class highlight using find_all.
